narrative.intro: Clark Construction Group is an active federal contractor in FY2026 to date. Clark Construction Group obligated $495M across 17 awards, with an average award size of $29.1M, and obligations were up 0.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the largest buyer, obligating $415M to Clark Construction Group, followed by the General Services Administration at $76.9M. Clark Construction Group is concentrated in building and heavy construction markets, with Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $316M and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $145M. Historical obligations show a multi-year profile: FY21 $167M, FY22 $178M, FY23 $603M, FY24 $1.6B, FY25 $492M, FY26 $495M. Clark Construction Group also holds smaller obligations with the Smithsonian Institution at $1.6M, the Department of Justice at $1.2M, and the Department of Health and Human Services at $953K. Clark Construction Group’s FY2026 to date totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year results.
